QUOTE: Declaring an `index_scope:` is the only thing that narrows the walk to chosen roots. ... "absent / unusable ──► whole_repo_scope(root)" ... "Whole repo, when nothing usable is declared."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope is tried first and that when it is absent or unusable, the result falls through to whole_repo_scope, which indexes the whole repository.
